statements.conditions: Withdrawn by vibe's own 2026-08-31 audit of its published papers: the cited code does not support the label as written. The audit regraded it: reproduced, L2, with prior art: Strauch 2006, Kurzynski 2008, Regensburger 2011, Kitagawa 2010, Asboth and Obuse 2013.
